scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && node scripts/check-backend.mjs
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.format: prettier --write backend/src backend/tests frontend/src frontend/index.html frontend/vite.config.js frontend/eslint.config.js e2e scripts playwright.config.js package.json compose.yaml render.yaml deploy/vercel.example.json .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check backend/src backend/tests frontend/src frontend/index.html frontend/vite.config.js frontend/eslint.config.js e2e scripts playwright.config.js package.json compose.yaml render.yaml deploy/vercel.example.json .github/workflows/ci.yml
